title: A malformed Red-run line fails the message, even beside a valid one
why: lint/check_red_run.py:70-77 passes a message when any one Red-run line is valid, and the failed form takes any command text, so a forgotten colon or a misspelt keyword (`mutant -> 1 failed on <sha>`, `mutants:`, `mutation:`) passes. Claude can write these by mistake. Main behaves the same; #1672 kept it.
note: Fix: a message fails when any Red-run line is malformed; narrow the failed form so mutant-like keywords are refused. Done check: lint/test_check_red_run.py cases red on main, and check_red_run over main's history (1733 messages) flips no existing trailer. Same file as step red-run-mutant-form: one lane for both fits. Filed from lane notes-fix-large-3 (#1672 round 2), 18:43 CST Nov 7.
